changelog: Burn-in now rejects unsafe, credential-bearing, or non-HTTP(S) video and subtitle URLs, including redirect targets
Subtitle downloads are capped at 2 MiB before parsing, preventing oversized remote text from exhausting the renderer
Timed caption input is bounded to 2,000 cues and 2,000 characters per cue for stable decoded-frame overlays
ASS/SSA Dialogue tracks, exclusive hardware rendering, and safe bounded MP4 output names remain supported
message: CS3M v658 — hardened optional subtitle burn-in input and renderer limits
